transcript: Speaker A: Menu card ki English se ghabra gaye kya? [Did you get scared by the English on the menu card?] Speaker B: Haan, kadhai paneer mangana tha, par bade restaurant ka menu dekhkar darr gaya. [Yes, I wanted to order kadhai paneer, but got scared looking at the big restaurant's menu.] Speaker A: Darna kyun? SpeakEasy app pe aao aur mujh AI tutor ke sath practice karo. [Why fear? Come to the SpeakEasy app and practice with me, the AI tutor.] Speaker B: Kya main akele mein, bina sharm ke, apni English theek kar sakta hoon? [Can I improve my English alone, without any shame?] Speaker A: Bilkul! 100 galtiyan karo, main bina judge kiye turant theek karoongi. [Absolutely! Make 100 mistakes, I will correct them instantly without judging.] Speaker B: Perfect! Ab bina darr ke order karne ke liye, main bhi SpeakEasy app download karta hoon. [Perfect! Now to order without fear, I am also downloading the SpeakEasy app.] Speaker C: Abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
